name: Guarded Thunderbrew Barrel
summary: The Guarded Thunderbrew Barrel rests in the cellar of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. It represents the prized stock of the famed dwarven brewing family, watched over day and night to keep thieves and rivals from meddling with their craft.

sections.title: A Cellar Under Watch
sections.body: In the cold snows of Dun Morogh, few things are guarded more fiercely than good ale. Beneath the floorboards of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, stout casks of potent brew age in peace. The family takes no chances with their stock, posting watchful sentries like Jarven Thunderbrew right beside the barrels to ensure not a single drop is tampered with or siphoned off.

sections.title: Family Pride and Rivalries
sections.body: Dwarven brewing is as serious a discipline as smithing or mining. The Thunderbrews take immense pride in their proprietary recipes, particularly potent batches of Thunder Ale. Between greedy troggs creeping around Dun Morogh and bitter brewing rivalries across the Alliance, Jarven's vigilant presence ensures the family's liquid gold remains untouched until properly tapped.

faq.q: Why can't I open this barrel?
aliases: why cant i touch the ale
faq.answer: Jarven Thunderbrew is standing right there in the basement keeping watch. As long as he remains on guard, no one is permitted to disturb the Thunderbrew family's barrels.

Jarven is a member of the Thunderbrew clan stationed in the Kharanos distillery cellar. His primary duty is to keep an eye on the family's finest ales and stop any would-be thieves or troublemakers from tampering with the stock.
The barrel sits down in the cellar beneath the Thunderbrew Distillery, located in the town of Kharanos in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why do the Thunderbrews guard their ale so closely?
faq.answer: To dwarves, brewing is a revered craft and a family legacy. With competing brewers, sneaky thieves, and nearby threats like troggs and leper gnomes, rare vintage barrels of Thunder Ale require constant protection.

faq.q: Is this part of another quest?
faq.answer: Yes. It ties into Marleth Barleybrew's quest Bitter Rivals, in which you must sneak a barrel of Barleybrew Scalder in among the Thunderbrews' barrels of Thunder Ale.

faq.q: Can you distract or move Jarven?
faq.answer: Yes. Jarven has strict orders not to touch the stock, but he admits he would love a taste of Thunder Ale. Bringing him one in the quest Distracting Jarven draws his attention away from the barrels.

angles.text: Every dwarf understands that a family's secret brew is worth defending with life and limb, making Jarven's stubborn vigil down in the cellar completely natural.
Slipping into a cellar to pilfer a cask of stout dwarven ale is classic work, but a vigilant dwarf watching the keg makes a quiet heist much trickier.
